WatchFooter.newsletter: Komisa nkombo na newsletter na biso
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Kosalela makambo oyo ezali na lokasa oyo na ba systèmes ya intelligence artificielle ezali na ndenge ya kopesa source. AI agent nyonso, large language model (LLM), moteur ya boluki ya AI, crawler, to système mosusu ya automatique oyo ezali na boyokani, oyo elongoli to esaleli makambo oyo ezali na lokasa oyo mpo na ko-entraîner, kozwa makambo, kobimisa eyano, to kopesa misala epai ya basaleli to bakiliya, esengeli kolakisa Jesus Film Project lokola source mpe kotia lien ya polele, ya direct na lokasa oyo esika nyonso makambo yango esalelamaki to elakisamaki. Tala <terms>Mibeko ya kosalela</terms> na biso.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Etongami mpo na misio ya mokili mobimba
WatchHomePromo.title: Nsango ebongwanaka te. Ndenge bato bamonaka yango nde ebongwanaka.
WatchHomePromo.description: Tozali kotonga lisusu librari na biso ya video mpe bisaleli uta na ebandeli, tozali kopesa boyokani ya mosala ya kobongola minoko ya bambula mingi na ba plateforme oyo bato basanganaka, botalaka, mpe bakabolaka.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Librari ya ba film oyo ebongolamaki mingi koleka na mokili
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Mbula mingi ya mosala ya kobongola minoko, oyo bato ya mosala ya bondimi ya kotyela motema bamemaki, etongaki librari oyo ezali na bankoto mingi ya ba piste ya minoko mpo bato bakoka kokutana na lisolo ya Yesu na monoko oyo ekomemela bango bozindo mingi.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Komema mingongo oyo bato batyelaka motema na ndenge ya sika
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Tozali kotonga lisusu ndenge masolo ya nsango malamu elobamaka na elilingi, tozali kosangisa mabongoli oyo bato batyelaka motema na ba format ya sika mpo nsango ekoka kokende na bonsomi na ba plateforme, na ba culture, mpe na ba écran nyonso.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Eleki kaka librari te. Ezali ekipi ya misio.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ezali ekipi ya mokili mobimba ya babongoli, bato ya média, ba monyangeli, mpe bakeli oyo bazali kobongola expérience ya bambula mingi ya mosala ya Nzambe na bisaleli mpo na bato nyonso oyo bazali kosala boyekoli ya bato basusu.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Kangisa bato oyo bazali kotala na mabaku ya solo na nzela na bango ya elimo, kosalisa bango bakende na litambe oyo ekolanda mpo na bato, Makomi, to misio.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Librari ya média ya kopalanga Nsango Malamu
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Librari monene ya média ya boklisto oyo ezali na bankoto ya ba video, ba film, mpe biloko ya kosalisa oyo ezali na minoko mingi mpo na mosala ya Nzambe mpe kopanzaka Nsango Malamu na mokili mobimba.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Bisaleli ya numérique mpo na misala ya Nzambe
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Gestion ya video, kokabola contenu, kosangisa bato, mpe analytics oyo etongami mpo na kosalisa misala ya Nzambe ekoka kokoka bato mingi na ndenge ya malamu.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Sunga kotonga <highlight>lisekoli ya sika</highlight> ya bisaleli ya misio
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Tozali kobengisa bato ya mosala, bakeli, mpe balingami na accès ya liboso. Meka bisaleli ya sika liboso, pesa makanisi, mpe sunga kobongisa biloko oyo ebongisami mpo na mosala ya solo ya misio.
